caption:
EOB or ERA? Same payment, two formats, and neither one is the money.

Kato checks the remittance against the bank deposit before anything is called reconciled.

Send this to whoever handles payment posting at your practice.

#dentalbilling #dentalofficemanager #paymentposting

slides.headline: An EOB is the document: what the payer paid, adjusted and denied, *claim by claim.*
An ERA is the same information as a file *your software can read.*
Neither one is *the money.* The bank deposit is.

Kato checks
*all of it.*
slides.sub: Remittance against deposit, before anything is called reconciled.
